title: Xdrip+ mi band 4
symptom: We connected xdrip and mi band 4, xdrip find it but it doesn't show readings on the screen except that sometimes the alarm goes off when on the phone.
fix: For the issue of not finding the band in the modified version, bigdigital suggests to regenerate auth code and connect the band from scratch: open patched MiFit app, unpair the band, delete all files in /sdcard/freemyband, pair again, then in xdrip miband menu switch off 'Use miband', clear 'mac address' and 'auth key', switch on 'Use miband', and ensure the mac address is correct. For the issue of 'Update BG manually' failing, Otter3eso57 suggests enabling or disabling the 'high MTU value' option under Settings->Smart Watch Features->MiBand, which resolved it for klettervirus.
evidence_quote: have you tried enabling or disabling the "high MTU value" option under Settings->Smart Watch Features->MiBand?
